blind.description: A compact cluster of five stylized miniature potion bottles or vials with wooden cork stoppers. The group includes a tall bulbous red bottle, a square-shouldered amber/gold bottle, a rounded dark green flask, a small droplet-shaped bronze vial, and a small cream-colored jug or jar. All surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with slight metallic or glossy finishes and natural tan cork stoppers. Each bottle sits upright directly on the floor with no plinth or fused geometry.
blind.from_above: A compact circular cluster of five colorful bottle tops arranged in a ring with a small hollow in the center, showing round red, green, cream, and brown circles plus one square orange top, each centered with a small tan cork circle.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely small compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure, standing roughly 1/8 to 1/7 its height (around 8 to 10 inches tall) and about 8 inches wide across the cluster.
